items.q: What did accuracy do from v1 to v11?

items.a: Only **instructions, skills and playbooks**—not the model.
A glossary so every term is defined and the agent **never guesses**.

items.q: What three scorers did they use?
items.a: **Code**, **LLM-as-judge** on traces, and **agent-as-judge** on flagged prices.

items.q: How did they rebuild the offline environment?
items.a: **Browser screenshots from v1** after archive.org failed for delivery apps.
To be **measured**, not to be good—start **narrow**.
**1/3 the image reads**, **>50% cost cut**, and an actual finished answer.
The **whole loop** (run, review exceptions, turn corrections into rules), not just the agent.
